pages.text: Code 1000: the server answered with a status of 400 or higher.
The message is the status line, like $(1)404 Not Found$(). The results $(1)result$(), $(1)status$() and $(1)headers$() are delivered as well, so a program that catches the error can read the answer.

$(1)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_GET problem$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/lamps/attic" ;$(br)  RESULT status status$(br)IF problem.code = 1000 AND status = 404 ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  CALL PRINT$(br)    PARAMETER value "There is no lamp in the attic" ;$(br)END IF$()
